about.title: Who am I?
bio: A self-taught developer and a graduate engineer of the Ecole Nationale d'Informatique in Fianarantsoa, I build mobile apps end to end: architecture, interface, back-end integration, then release on the App Store and Google Play.

I mainly work with Flutter and Dart. On the server side, I connect my apps to custom back-ends through REST or GraphQL APIs, or set up Supabase and Firebase when the project calls for it. My career has also led me to use Java, Kotlin and the Android SDK, as well as TypeScript and Next.js for the web.
I use AI as an assistant: it helps me explore an idea, prototype, and write tests or documentation faster. Architecture, technical decisions and code review remain my responsibility.
Curious by nature, I regularly set time aside to keep up with the latest technologies and explore new tools.

career.title: Career
professionalIntro: From an Android development internship to designing complete apps published on the stores, each role has broadened my scope: mobile, back-end and systems administration.
Here are the main steps of my professional career:
academicIntro: I trained at the Ecole Nationale d'Informatique (ENI) in Fianarantsoa, from the bachelor's degree to the professional master's, after a scientific baccalaureate that confirmed my interest in science and technology.

consulting.title: Consultant developer
bullets: Design and development of Flutter mobile apps, from architecture to release on the App Store and Google Play
Integration of custom REST APIs built by back-end teams
Setting up Supabase and Firebase back-ends: PostgreSQL data model, row-level security, Edge Functions and Cloud Functions
Integration of payments (Stripe, in-app purchases), push notifications and generative AI features
Implementation of designs with care for the user experience, and back-offices built with Jet Admin
Maintenance and evolution of production apps, with continuous integration (GitLab CI) and automated tests
AI-assisted development, with every change reviewed and validated
